text.autoconfig.autosketch.title: Autosketch
text.autoconfig.autosketch.option.bridge: TCP port for the MCP connection on 127.0.0.1 (0 to 65535).
0 picks a free port on every start (written to config/autosketch-bridge.toml).
text.autoconfig.autosketch.option.patche: Most blocks a patch writes per server tick (1 to 10,000,000); larger patches continue on the next ticks.
text.autoconfig.autosketch.option.tracki: Most changed positions one dirty notice lists (1 to 4096).
Beyond it the notice says "everything" and the MCP compares section hashes.
hook: a mixin on chunk block writes (immediate). scan: periodic comparison of the volumes' sections,
which also sees writers that bypass the hook, such as Axiom; the mixin is then not applied (read at game start).
Ticks for the scan tracker to compare every section of the volumes once (1 to 1200).
text.autoconfig.autosketch.option.volume: Most blocks the context boxes may cover in total, so snapshots stay practical.
Any stack of this item, held in the main hand by an op, is the wand (e.g. minecraft:blaze_rod).
Left click sets corner 1, right click corner 2; the item and the block are never used.
text.autoconfig.autosketch.option.feedba: Whether action-bar notices are on for a player who hasn't set /autosketch notices.
text.autoconfig.autosketch.option.prompt: A short top-level root for the request commands (e.g. "as" gives /as build <text>), or empty for none.
How far the crosshair block is looked for when a request attaches game context (1 to 512).
text.autoconfig.autosketch.option.discov: Write <user.home>/.autosketch/games/<hash>.toml on server start, so a local Autosketch MCP can find this game.
Off: nothing is written there and this game's old file is removed.
